text: Implementing a statistical validation contract layered on fold-safe ModelSpec: explicit row/column/entry/group/site/error resampling; separate fixed-mask, MCAR, MAR-sensitivity, and MNAR-sensitivity targets; a required fold-local manifest for offsets, scaling, loss balancing, graphs, encodings, rank, and penalties; deterministic within-fold warm-start lineage; complete adversarial simulation coverage; typed recovery/calibration metrics; and claim admission that labels empirical results and rejects support-recovery or inferential claims without a theorem witness.
